event.description:
Another Set championship for Grand Archive!

Entry fee: $20
Player cap: 32 
Event structure:  5 Rounds swiss, Bo3 + standard overtime (NO TOP CUT)
Event schedule: Check in 10:00AM - 10:50AM / Round 1 Start: 11:00 AM

Prizing: 
Entry comes with: 1 PTM Event pack, 1 PTM Booster pack, 1 Store champ promo
Booster pack per Swiss Round Win
Top finishers: 
1ST - 1 National Qualifier Card, 1 Champion Playmat, 8 PTM Booster Packs, 4 Event Packs
2ND - 6 PTM Booster Packs, 3 Event Packs 
3RD - 4 PTM Booster Packs, 2 Event Packs 
4TH - 4 PTM Booster Packs, 1 Event Pack 
5TH - 8TH: 2 PTM Booster Packs, 1 Event Pack

*Booster packs will be given out while supply last, if not, it will be replaced by store credit in equal value amount

Registration: In person / call the store / dm the store discord account to reserve a spot, we will need your full name phone number, AND OMNIDEX ID number.

Join our discord to talk to the community at https://discord.gg/VSXnYyQRa2
